workflow.name: Monitor TikTok competitors with Scavio AI, Google Sheets, and Gmail alerts
workflow.description:
## How it works

1. Every 6 hours, reads competitor TikTok usernames from a Google Sheet.
2. Resolves each username to a TikTok profile and fetches the 5 most recent posts via the Scavio API.
3. Compares fetched posts against the last known video ID to detect new content.
4. Logs every new post to a **Posts** tab with description, views, likes, comments, shares, and a direct TikTok link.
5. Sends a Gmail alert summarizing what each competitor just posted.
6. Saves `sec_user_id` and `last_video_id` back to the **Competitors** tab so the next run picks up where it left off.

## Set up steps

1. Install the **Scavio** community node (`n8n-nodes-scavio`) from Settings > Community Nodes.
2. Get a free Scavio API key at [dashboard.scavio.dev](https://dashboard.scavio.dev) -- 250 credits/mo on the free tier.
3. Create a Google Sheet with two tabs:
   - **Competitors** -- columns: `username`, `sec_user_id`, `last_video_id`. Add one TikTok username per row (without @). Leave `sec_user_id` and `last_video_id` blank; they are auto-populated.
   - **Posts** -- columns: `username`, `description`, `views`, `likes`, `comments`, `shares`, `link`, `detected_at`.
4. Open each Google Sheets node, attach your Google Sheets OAuth2 credential, and select your spreadsheet and tab.
5. Open the **Alert new posts** Gmail node and set `sendTo` to your email address.
6. Attach your Scavio API credential to the **Get Profile** and **Get Latest Posts** nodes.
7. Activate the workflow.

## Categories

Marketing, Social Media, TikTok, Competitor Analysis

## Cost

Each competitor uses 2 Scavio API credits per run (1 profile lookup + 1 posts fetch). Running 5 competitors every 6 hours uses ~20 credits/day, fitting comfortably within the free tier of 250 credits/month.

parameters.content:
## TikTok Competitor Monitor with Scavio + Google Sheets

### How it works
This workflow monitors competitor TikTok accounts for new posts. Every 6 hours it reads usernames from a Google Sheet, fetches their latest videos via Scavio, compares against the last known video ID, and logs every new post with its description, metrics, and direct link to a Posts tab. If new content is found, you get a Gmail alert.

Powered by [Scavio](https://scavio.dev), a real-time search API for Google, Amazon, Walmart, YouTube, Reddit, and TikTok. Free tier: 250 credits per month.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Install the **Scavio** community node: Settings -> Community Nodes -> install `n8n-nodes-scavio`.
- [ ] Get a free Scavio API key at https://dashboard.scavio.dev (250 credits/mo).
- [ ] Create a Google Sheet with two tabs:
  - **Competitors**: columns `username`, `sec_user_id` (leave blank), `last_video_id` (leave blank). Add one competitor per row.
  - **Posts**: columns `username`, `description`, `views`, `likes`, `comments`, `shares`, `link`, `detected_at`.
- [ ] Attach credentials: Scavio API on **Get Profile** + **Get Latest Posts**, Google Sheets OAuth2 on all sheet nodes, Gmail OAuth2 on **Alert new posts**.
- [ ] Open sheet nodes and pick your spreadsheet/tabs.
- [ ] Open **Alert new posts** and set `sendTo` to your email.
- [ ] Activate the workflow.

### Tips
- The first run seeds `last_video_id` without alerting. Alerts start on the second run.
- Each competitor costs 2 credits per run. 5 competitors every 6h fits the free tier.
- Build charts in Google Sheets from the Posts tab to compare competitor posting frequency and engagement.

### How can we improve this workflow?
### [>>> Share your feedback at scavio.dev/feedback](https://scavio.dev)

## 1. Read competitors

Fires every 6 hours and reads every row from the "Competitors" tab (one row = one TikTok account to monitor).

## 2. Check for new posts

For each competitor, resolves the sec_user_id via Get Profile, fetches the 5 newest posts, and compares the latest video_id against the stored last_video_id to detect new content.

## 3. Alert, log & save

If new posts are found, sends a Gmail alert, logs each post with description, metrics, and link to the Posts tab. Always saves sec_user_id and last_video_id back to the Competitors tab.

The IF node can be used to implement binary conditional logic in your workflow. You can set up one-to-many conditions to evaluate each item of data being inputted into the node. That data will either evaluate to TRUE or FALSE and route out of the node accordingly.

This node has multiple types of conditions: Bool, String, Number, and Date & Time.
